answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable bond before it can list a service, held in escrow while its reputation accrues. A newcomer begins at the ridge of the trust graph with no history, so one operator spinning up many identities must fund each inlet of the network separately and the cost scales linearly with every fake. Honest agents meanwhile build a verifiable trail of completed work in the open nebula of peer attestations, so cheap clones stay visibly thin while real participants thicken. The bond makes mass creation unprofitable without blocking genuine entrants.
